assumptions: Party of 2 adults and 2 children (ages 4-7), one hotel room or condo that sleeps 4, five nights. Christmas week is Dec 21-26, 2026. February comparison week is Feb 1-6, 2027 (not Presidents Day week). Home airport is IAH. Drive hours are Rome2Rio road times from Conroe unless noted. White Christmas probability is NOAA 1991-2020 chance of at least 1 inch of snow on the ground on Dec 25 at the named station. Snow depth is resort average base depth from OnTheSnow where a ski area exists; that is mountain base, not the town sidewalk. Lodging and airfare single numbers are estimates from published ranges on pages opened, not a completed booking for those exact dates, because live fare calendars did not return extractable prices. Flight hours are the shortest published IAH itinerary (nonstop when one exists).

destinations.name: Breckenridge

kid_activities.name: Carter Park ice rink and free downtown snow play
kid_activities.note: Walkable historic Main Street; rink and sled hills are the easy snow memory, not expert terrain.

kid_activities.name: Breckenridge beginner ski school on Peak 8
kid_activities.note: Price for a half-day kids lesson was not on a page I could extract. Book early in Christmas week.

kid_activities.name: Summit Express airport shuttle as the arrival adventure
kid_activities.note: Rome2Rio lists the DEN-Breckenridge shuttle at about $65 and 2.5 hours. Not a play activity, but the mountain approach is the first nature moment.

destinations.nature_highlight: Victorian mining town at the base of the Tenmile Range, with the Blue River through town and high peaks immediately above Main Street.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: A real snowy storybook street they can walk, plus beginner snow school, without needing expert ski terrain.
destinations.risks: Town sits near 9,600 feet; small kids can get altitude sickness, poor sleep, and headaches. I-70 winter closures and the 2.5-hour airport transfer. Christmas week sells out with multi-night minimums. Lows near 0 F.

destinations.name: Estes Park

kid_activities.name: Rocky Mountain National Park vehicle entry
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: vehicle pass covers all passengers; walk-in fee starts at age 16
kid_activities.note: NPS 7-day private vehicle pass is $35. Trail Ridge Road is closed in winter, so stay on lower valleys and look for elk.

kid_activities.name: Elk watching in town and along the Big Thompson
kid_activities.note: Winter elk in the valley is the memory most 4-to-7-year-olds keep. Keep distance.

kid_activities.name: Estes Park Aerial Tramway to Prospect Mountain
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: none stated on the page opened
kid_activities.note: Wikipedia notes the tram to Prospect Mountain. Fare was not on the page I opened.

destinations.nature_highlight: Gateway to Rocky Mountain National Park, with elk in the valley and Longs Peak above town when clouds lift.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Wild animals in a snowy mountain town at an altitude small lungs handle better than a 9,600-foot ski base.
destinations.risks: Only about a 75 percent chance of an inch of snow on Christmas, so a brown Christmas is possible. Trail Ridge Road is closed, limiting the high park. Holiday lodging still books up. Windy canyon roads from Denver.

destinations.name: Steamboat Springs

kid_activities.name: Howelsen Hill tubing and beginner ski hill
kid_activities.note: Town hill, not the big resort. Lesson price was not on a page I opened.

kid_activities.name: Strawberry Park Hot Springs soak
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: young children allowed with an adult; some pools are hotter
kid_activities.note: The kid-memorable piece: snow on the ground and warm water. Exact 2026 day-pass price was not extracted.

kid_activities.name: Yampa River walk and downtown snow play
kid_activities.note: Walkable town at a kinder elevation than Breckenridge.

destinations.nature_highlight: A real ranching valley with champagne-powder mountains and natural hot springs, not only a lift-served resort.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Near-certain snow, a small-town ski hill, and hot springs they can actually sit in after playing outside.
destinations.risks: HDN winter flights can cancel in storms. Christmas week is sold out with minimum stays. The 4WD road to Strawberry Park can close; use the shuttle. Still cold, with lows in the single digits.

destinations.name: Winter Park

kid_activities.name: Winter Park Resort beginner ski school
kid_activities.note: Family resort with a long beginner record. Lesson price not extracted.

kid_activities.name: Tubing hill at the resort
kid_activities.note: The no-lesson snow activity for ages 4 to 7. Price not on the history page opened.

kid_activities.name: Fraser River trail snow walk in town
kid_activities.note: Short, flat, and close to lodging.

destinations.nature_highlight: Fraser Valley at the west portal of the Moffat Tunnel, with a high snow probability and forested Continental Divide scenery an hour and a half from Denver.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Almost sure snow and a purpose-built family resort, closer to the airport than Breckenridge.
destinations.risks: Base near 9,100 feet is still hard on small kids. Berthoud Pass can close. Christmas week minimum-stay rules. Temperatures below are estimates, not a town normals table I opened.

destinations.name: Red River

kid_activities.name: Red River Ski Area beginner hill and tubing
kid_activities.note: Small ski town where kids can walk from lodging to snow. Lesson price not extracted.

kid_activities.name: Free town trolley
kid_activities.note: Wikipedia notes a free trolley inside town limits. Easy with tired 4-year-olds.

kid_activities.name: Enchanted Circle scenic drive toward Wheeler Peak and Taos
kid_activities.note: The nature day: Sangre de Cristo peaks and Carson National Forest. Winter road closures possible.

destinations.nature_highlight: A one-street mining town in the Sangre de Cristo Mountains on the Enchanted Circle, with Wheeler Peak nearby.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Small enough that the whole vacation is the snowy main street, and a long drive instead of a complicated flight.
destinations.risks: Drive is 14 hours 39 minutes, just over a 14-hour day, so plan an overnight or share the driving. About a 1-in-3 chance Christmas is not white. Bobcat Pass can close. Altitude is still 8,688 feet.

destinations.name: Ruidoso

kid_activities.name: Ski Apache beginner area
kid_activities.note: The local ski hill above town. Snow odds and lesson prices were not confirmed.

kid_activities.name: Inn of the Mountain Gods lakeside walk
kid_activities.note: A gentle nature stop if the high road is open. Not verified open every winter day.

kid_activities.name: Town sledding hill
kid_activities.note: Assume a free hill exists; I did not open a park page confirming a named hill and rules.

destinations.nature_highlight: Sacramento Mountains pines above the Tularosa Basin, the closest real mountain town within a 14-hour drive of Conroe.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: They can say they drove to the mountains and played in snow, if the snow is actually there.
destinations.risks: NOAA station for Ruidoso had insufficient data for a white-Christmas percent, so snow is not confirmed. Southern New Mexico often has thin or patchy December snow. Mountain roads ice over. Flying via Roswell is a long connection, so driving is the point of this pick.

destinations.name: Jackson

kid_activities.name: Grand Teton National Park scenic drive
kid_activities.note: NPS 7-day private vehicle fee is $35. Inner park roads may be closed; the moose-Wilson and highway views still work in winter.

kid_activities.name: National Elk Refuge horse-drawn sleigh
kid_activities.note: The classic kid wildlife ride. Fare was not on a page I opened.

kid_activities.name: Town Square elk-antler arch walk
kid_activities.note: Free and short. Pair with a hot chocolate stop when the high is only 26 F.

destinations.nature_highlight: The Tetons rising out of the valley, with thousands of elk on the National Elk Refuge in winter.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Wildlife they can see from a sleigh, plus a real mountain skyline, at a town elevation easier than Summit County.
destinations.risks: December high is only 26 F, which is a short outdoor window for ages 4 to 7. JAC nonstop can cancel. Christmas lodging sells out. Jackson town snow-on-ground percent was missing in NOAA; 93 percent is the nearby Mammoth station, not Jackson itself. Resort base depth is the ski hill, not the town square.

destinations.name: Truckee

kid_activities.name: Northstar tubing and beginner ski school
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: height rules on the tubing hill
kid_activities.note: Northstar is the gentle Tahoe resort next to Truckee. Lesson and tube prices were not on the snow-history page.

kid_activities.name: Donner Lake snow walk
kid_activities.note: Flat lakeshore with a pioneer story. Stay off ice unless a ranger says it is safe.

kid_activities.name: Downtown Truckee historic street
kid_activities.note: A walkable railroad town at only about 5,800 feet, kinder on small kids than Summit County.

destinations.nature_highlight: Donner Lake and the Sierra crest, with Lake Tahoe a short drive south when the highway is open.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: High chance of snow on the ground, a lower town elevation, and a lake-and-pines landscape that does not look like Colorado.
destinations.risks: I-80 over Donner Summit closes in storms. Christmas week in Tahoe is packed. Flight hours and fares are estimates; I did not open a live IAH-RNO calendar. Temperatures are estimates, not a normals table I opened.
